correctness.rationale: The traveling-wave ODE is derived directly from the PDE. evidence: Harko and Mak, arXiv:1510.08163v1, §§II–III: the Abel reduction yields exact waves under explicit Chiellini/Lemke integrability relations; the solved subclasses inspected include constant convection and specified transformed DQ forms.
